summary: Iteration 125: Inline Remote Button Backend Regression - All 13 tests PASSED. Verified all backend endpoints used by the new inline RemoteAccessButton on DevicesPage. GET /api/devices returns 135 devices with required fields (id, name, status, rustdesk_id, trmm_agent_id). GET /api/remote-providers/active returns active providers (RustDesk found). POST /api/rustdesk/quick-connect works for devices with rustdesk_id. GET /api/trmm/agents/{id}/remote-url returns success=false when TRMM not configured. All smoke tests pass (health, auth, trmm/status, remote-providers).
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/devices: Returns 135 devices with all fields needed by RemoteAccessButton (id, name, status, rustdesk_id, trmm_agent_id)
GET /api/remote-providers/active: Returns list of active+configured providers - RustDesk found in seed data
POST /api/rustdesk/quick-connect: Works correctly for devices with rustdesk_id - returns 200 with relay_server info
GET /api/trmm/agents/{id}/remote-url: Returns 200 with success=false and message='Tactical RMM not configured' when TRMM not configured (wrapped error pattern)
All endpoints require authentication (401/403 without token)
No routes broken by adding providersOverride prop to RemoteAccessButton - backend endpoints stable
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tests use existing devices and RustDesk config from seed data
